name: cc-for-pein
description: Experimental checkout-owned Claude Code Agent runtime with bounded leaf/Fable delegation, durable roots, complete completion delivery, native message history, interruption, and exact-session follow-up.

interface.shortDescription: Experimental durable local Claude Agents for Codex
interface.longDescription: Experimentally run the host Claude Code CLI through a checkout-owned Agent runtime with bounded leaf/Fable delegation, durable messages, bounded progress, complete completion delivery, recent native message history, interruption, exact-session continuation, and terminal-parity execution.
defaultPrompt: Use $cc-for-pein:spawn-agent with mcp__cc_for_pein__spawn_agent to create an Experimental named Claude Agent and retain required join obligations
Use $cc-for-pein:followup-task with mcp__cc_for_pein__followup_task to continue a Claude Agent
Use $cc-for-pein:list-agents with mcp__cc_for_pein__list_agents to inspect local Claude Agent work
Use $cc-for-pein:read-agent-messages with mcp__cc_for_pein__read_agent_messages to retrieve an earlier native Claude message without activating the Agent
